As Binance conducts regular reviews of its programs to provide users with the most value and competitive services, Binance is launching a limited-time Spot Taker Program Promotion, effective from 2026-11-09 00:00 (UTC).
Key Highlights
The promotion introduces three discount tiers — 5%, 10% and 15% — with the entry threshold set at a weekly Spot taker volume share of 0.05%.
The promotion covers USDT-quoted and USDC-quoted Spot pairs. Both quote assets are assessed together under a single track, and the discount is distributed separately for each quote asset.
No application or enrollment is required. Users who meet the qualification criteria are automatically identified and rewarded.
The Binance Spot Taker Program Promotion is as follows:
Fee Tier · Weekly Spot Taker Volume Share on USDT-Quoted and USDC-Quoted Spot Pairs · Taker Fee Discount
cells: Weekly Spot Taker Volume Share on USDT-Quoted and USDC-Quoted Spot Pairs

blocks.x: Please Note
No application or enrollment is required. Users who meet the qualification criteria in a given assessment week will be automatically identified and included in the promotion.

The taker fee discount will not be applied directly to trades. Instead, it will be distributed to the Spot Account of the user's master account before the Friday of the week following the discount period:
Taker fees paid on USDT-quoted pairs are returned as a USDT distribution;
Taker fees paid on USDC-quoted pairs are returned as a USDC distribution.

The first assessment week of this promotion will run from 2026-11-02 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-08 23:59 (UTC). The taker fee discount based on this first assessment week will be applied during 2026-11-10 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-16 23:59 (UTC). The discount generated during this period will be credited to eligible users' master accounts' Spot Accounts before 2026-11-20 23:59 (UTC). Subsequent assessment weeks will follow the same weekly cycle, with the applicable discount period and credit timing set out in the example above.
Please note that in special circumstances, the distribution may be delayed.
Distribution amount = Taker fees actually paid during the assessment week * discount rate
USDT distribution = Taker fees actually paid (USDT-quoted pairs) * discount rate
USDC distribution = Taker fees actually paid (USDC-quoted pairs) * discount rate
Taker fees actually paid = Taker fees charged to the user after their VIP tier rates, USDC-pair discount and any BNB discount have been applied
Trading volume and taker fees generated by sub-accounts will be aggregated at the master account level for the purpose of tier assessment and distribution.
No daily or weekly report will be provided for the Spot Taker Program Promotion. Users may refer to their account transaction records for the distributed rewards.
Trading volume and fees on Spot and Margin pairs under zero fee promotions (i.e., where zero maker and taker fees apply) will be excluded from calculation.
For more information and further inquiries, users can email mmprogram@binance.com or contact their sales and key account coverage teams directly.
Terms & Conditions
Binance Spot Taker Program Promotion will be reviewed on a weekly basis (Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 23:59 UTC).

Weekly Spot Taker Volume Share is defined by the user's weekly taker transaction volume on all eligible USDT-quoted and USDC-quoted Spot pairs divided by the weekly total taker transaction volume on the same set of pairs across the Binance Spot market.
All participants' eligibility to receive the taker fee discount is reviewed once a week based on the previous week's performance.
Self-trades will be excluded from volume calculations.
All trading volumes and metrics related to the promotion are measured by Binance at its sole and absolute discretion.

Fellow Binancians,

From 2026-10-30 00:00 (UTC), Binance will continue the airdrop campaign rewarding all eligible users who hold World Liberty Financial USD (USD1) on our platform. Eligible users will share rewards from a grand prize pool of 120 million World Liberty Financial (WLFI) tokens and up to 2.5 million USD1 tokens.Please note that WLFI rewards and USD1 rewards are stackable and follow different reward schedules:
WLFI rewards: Accrue during the Campaign Period between 2026-10-30 00:00 (UTC) and 2026-11-27 00:00 (UTC), distributed weekly every Friday;

USD1 rewards: Eligible users must complete their qualifying deposit during the enrollment window between 2026-10-16 00:00 (UTC) and 2026-11-27 00:00 (UTC) (the enrollment window is extended), while USD1 holdings will continue to be evaluated through the applicable payout dates on 2026-12-11 and 2027-01-08.
WLFI Rewards
To qualify for the WLFI Rewards, eligible users must hold and maintain at least 0.01 USD1 in balance (net assets), in any of the following account categories on Binance:
Spot Account;
Funding Account;
Margin Account (USD1 as Collateral in Cross Margin, Isolated Margin, or Portfolio Margin);
USDⓈ-M Futures Account (USD1 as Collateral in USDⓈ-M Futures Accounts, Multi-Assets mode is included).

USD1 acquired through borrowing of other stablecoins will receive a haircut of 70%, after accounting for liabilities in Margin Accounts from other stablecoins, including USDT, USDC, U, RLUSD, and FDUSD.
WLFI rewards of sub-accounts will be distributed to the Spot Account of the corresponding sub-accounts.
USD1 Rewards
In the following scenarios, on top of the WLFI rewards, USD1 holdings will receive additional USD1 rewards,
USD1 rewards are distributed only to the master account. Sub-account balances are aggregated at the master account level for calculation.

Campaign Details
Distribution: Rewards will be airdropped directly to eligible users’ Binance Spot Accounts.
Distribution Frequency: Weekly airdrops during the Campaign Period.
Reward Distribution
Rewards start accruing from 2026-10-30 00:00 (UTC). Weekly rewards will be distributed by 18:00 (UTC) every Friday in WLFI tokens. Distribution records can be found in Distribution History.
The Weekly Reward Amount will be roughly calculated as follows:
Qualifying Balance of each day = Lowest USD1 balance captured during those hourly snapshots on each day.
Weekly Rewards = (7-day average of the Qualifying Balance * Effective APR on the distribution day * 7) / 365

After each weekly distribution, the effective APR for that period will be updated in this announcement. In determining the effective APR on the distribution day, Binance will take into account a number of factors, including, without limitation:
Minimum recorded amount of Open Interest per day;
Lowest balance of the snapshots each day;
The daily aggregated amount of Qualifying Balances across all eligible holders of USD1;
7-day average across all eligible holders of USD1
For USD1 acquired through borrowing other stablecoins:
Eligible balance in Margin Account = USD1 Balance Before Leverage + Leveraged Amount * (1 - 70%):
USD1 Balance before Leverage = MAX [USD1 Balance in Margin Account - Margin Account Liabilities of the Other Stablecoins, 0]
Leveraged Amount = USD1 Balance in Margin Account - MAX [USD1 Balance in Margin Account - Margin Account Liabilities of the Other Stablecoins, 0]
Note: ”Other Stablecoins” include USDT, USDC, U, RLUSD, FDUSD.

Among this borrowed 5,000 USD1, 4,000 USD1 was used as collateral in Margin, the remaining 1,000 USD1 was held in their Spot Account in week 1. The effective base APR is 20%, effective boosted APR is 24%, User B’s rewards due to be received at the end of week 1 will be as follows:

User C had 1,000 USD1 in the Margin Account and used it as collateral to borrow 4,000 USDT through Margin (“Liabilities of the other Stablecoins”), then converted this 4,000 USDT to USD1. The user now holds 5,000 USD1 in Margin (“USD1 Balance”) in week 1. The effective base APR is 20%, effective boosted APR is 24%, User C’s rewards due to be received at the end of week 1 will be as follows:
Important Notes

Users’ USD1 Qualifying Balance will be calculated as net assets (assets minus liabilities). USD1 as liabilities (e.g., borrowed from VIP Loans, Margin loan, etc.) will be excluded from the Qualifying Balance for this campaign.

Snapshots of user balances and total qualifying balances will be taken at any point of time each hour to get users’ hourly balances in the above mentioned account categories. The lowest USD1 balance captured during those snapshots on each day will constitute their Qualifying Balance and be used to calculate their rewards
For example, a user’s lowest USD1 balance captured on 2026-10-31 is zero, then their qualifying balance for that day is zero.
At any snapshot time, any one of users’ supported assets must be greater than 0.01 USD1 to be included in the calculation.
Users are recommended to maintain their USD1 holding throughout the Campaign Period to maximize their rewards.
Rewards distributed are rounded down to 2 decimal places. Please note that the distribution time is not guaranteed and may change from time to time.
There is no individual cap on rewards. Users’ rewards depend on their qualifying balance relative to the total qualifying balance of all eligible users and other factors.
Stay tuned for weekly reward distributions and updates on the Campaign.

WLFI token value for airdrop distribution will be based on the official Binance market closing price one day before the airdrop distribution day.

We are launching a long-term program, the "Merchant Referral Program". For each merchant you successfully refer to join Binance P2P, you can receive a token voucher worth 50 USDC. The referred merchant may also receive a token voucher worth 50 or 100 USDC for completing the trading tasks.
How to Participate
Step 1. Log in to your binance account and complete identity verification. If you are already verified, proceed to Step 2.
Step 2. Fill in and submit the referral form.
Step 3. The referred merchant completes onboarding.
Binance merchants must submit an application and pass verification via this link.
Merchants and experienced traders from other platforms must submit an application and pass verification via this link.
Step 4. The referred merchant completes the first trade. They post a P2P ad and complete their first P2P trade. After verification, the referrer receives 50 USDC in token voucher.
Step 5. The referred merchant completes the trading tasks. After completing Level 1 or 2, they receive a token voucher worth 50 or 100 USDC.
Trading Tasks for Referred Merchants
Trade only with the eligible fiat currencies: KZT, KGS, AMD, AZN, GEL, TJS, BYN, UAH, MDL. Referred Merchants can receive rewards according to the following requirements:
Level 1: Complete 60 P2P trades with different users, reaching a total volume of at least 20,000 USDT equivalent. Reward: 50 USDC.
Level 2: Complete 120 P2P trades with different users, reaching a total volume of at least 40,000 USDT equivalent. Reward: 100 USDC.
Note: Users can receive only one reward. If a user completes both tasks they will receive the highest reward they are eligible for.
Merchant Eligibility Criteria
The referred merchant must fulfill all of the requirements:
This campaign is only available to new Binance P2P merchants whose Binance account KYC country / region is Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Tajikistan, Belarus, Ukraine, Moldova.
Be an active merchant for at least 10 days from the onboarding date (cumulative, not necessarily consecutive). A day counts as active if it has at least one completed order.
Order completion rate must be at least 80% within 30 days of onboarding.
Results Evaluation

Results are evaluated every two weeks. The referrer receives the reward on the nearest review date after the referred merchant's onboarding and first completed trade are confirmed. The referred merchant receives the reward on the review date after completing Level 1 or 2 tasks.

If a level has not yet been completed, the merchant remains in the program and is checked in the next cycle. Trading tasks must be completed no more than 30 days from the referred merchant's onboarding date. Tasks not completed within this period are not counted toward the program.
Refer Now

Share your referral link, and when your referees complete their first trade of $5 or more, you each unlock Mystery Boxes packed with USDT rewards worth up to $25 each, with a total prize pool of $500,000 in USDT token vouchers.
More referees, more trades, more Mystery Boxes. Plus, top referrers compete for an exclusive $50,000 leaderboard bonus pool.
Join Now
Promotion A: Referral Rush: Invite Friends to Share a 500,000 USDT Token Vouchers Prize Pool
How to Participate
Step 1: Visit the activity page and click [Join Now] on the pop-up to confirm your participation.

Step 2: Invite friends via your campaign-designated referral link/code to complete both of the following tasks during the Promotion Period. For each successful referral* who completes all of the following tasks, you and your referee will both be eligible to unlock a Mystery Box each:
Task 1: Deposit at least $5 or equivalent (cumulative) via P2P deposit.
Task 2: Trade eligible trading pairs and reach at least $5 or equivalent (cumulative) via Binance Spot, Convert, or Futures.
Task 3: Referees must download the Binance App and have at least one login record.
Step 3: Unlock the Mystery Box on the activity page to claim your reward. Token vouchers will be distributed to both the referrer and the referee's Rewards Hub respectively.**
Each Mystery Box contains up to $25 in USDT token vouchers, available on a first-come, first-served basis.
Please Note:

*A successful referral refers to a newly referred user who registers on Binance via the referrer’s limited-time activity referral link, completes identity verification (KYC), and completes the aforementioned tasks during the Promotion Period.

**Each eligible user may unlock a maximum of 10 Mystery Boxes, on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to the prize pool availability. It might take up to 48 hours for the USDT token voucher to be credited to the user's account.

Binance P2P is excited to launch a new promotion for our P2P merchants in Kenya! During the Promotion Period, eligible merchants who use Lightning Instant M-pesa & Instant M-pesa Paybill for their P2P advertisements can earn monthly rewards in USDT token vouchers.
Benefits of Using Lightning Instant M-pesa & Instant M-pesa Paybill
0 Maker Fee: Enjoy zero maker fees on your trades.
USDT Rewards: Earn extra USDT rewards every month.
Efficient Processing: Experience faster and more efficient order processing.
Serve More Users: Get more opportunities to serve buyers, including first-time P2P users.
Reward Structure
Merchants can qualify for multiple reward categories simultaneously. All rewards are in USDT.
1. Activation Bonus (One-Time)
Reward: 70 USDT token voucher
How to Qualify: Complete your first 25 eligible orders (minimum 5 USDT equivalent each) with at least 10 unique counterparties, using Lightning Instant M-pesa & Instant M-pesa Paybill
2. Monthly Usage Incentive
Reward: 30 USDT per month
How to Qualify: Complete at least 50 eligible orders (minimum 5 USDT equivalent each) with at least 15 unique counterparties in a calendar month while maintaining healthy service metrics.
3. Monthly Top Performer Leaderboard
Reward Pool: 500 USDT per month
Merchant must meet all criteria below to qualify:
Eligible order count: At least 500 completed Eligible Orders.
Eligible volume: At least 5,000 USDT equivalent in total Eligible Volume
Service quality: Completion rate of at least 95% (and any additional quality checks as determined by Binance)
Ranking will be determined based on the highest number of completed Eligible Orders, ranked from highest to the lowest.
Rank · Reward per Eligible User
1st Place · 150 USDT
2nd Place · 125 USDT

4th-10th Place · 25 USDT each

Kraken was named Fintech Company of the Year – Established at the Business Post’s National Fintech Awards 2026 in Dublin.
The Fintech Company of the Year award recognizes innovation, progress, and market influence, judged on product advances, measurable results, and impact on the wider Irish fintech industry.
We were shortlisted alongside some of the biggest names in Irish fintech.
Ireland remains central to how we serve clients across the EEA.
On October 15, Kraken was named Fintech Company of the Year – Established at the fourth annual National Fintech Awards, held at the Round Room at the Mansion House in Dublin.
We were up against a strong shortlist of established fintech companies, and we’re proud to bring the award home for the work we’ve put into building and scaling in Ireland.
What the National Fintech Awards recognize

Organized by the Business Post in association with GRID Finance, the National Fintech Awards celebrate achievement across the Irish fintech industry, from early-stage start-ups to the most established names. The 2026 awards spanned 17 categories, each judged against its own criteria.

The Fintech Company of the Year awards look for companies that show real innovation, progress, and market influence. Entrants set out their mission and market focus, the products and strategic advances they delivered over the past year, and the measurable results behind them, including growth, users, revenue, and impact. Winners have to show strong momentum, clear value for customers, and a visible effect on the wider industry.
Why Ireland

Ireland is a core part of how we serve clients across Europe. Our Irish entities are regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland and provide crypto brokerage and MiCA custody to clients in the EEA, and operate our MiCA-authorized trading platform. Payward also holds an EMI license from the Central Bank of Ireland, which sits alongside our other regulated infrastructure as part of Payward Banking.

We didn’t build here to tick a box. We built here because Ireland offers the talent, the regulatory clarity, and the fintech ecosystem you need to build a global financial services company that clients can trust.
Building on a regulated foundation

We think about growth in Ireland the same way we think about growth everywhere: one license, one market, one layer of infrastructure at a time. A clear regulatory framework lets us build the products clients actually use and stand behind them with confidence. Those products need to be secure, transparent, and ready to scale.

That approach is also why Europe features so prominently in our wider roadmap. Earlier this month, Payward signed a definitive agreement to acquire Saldo Bank, a digital-first, EU-licensed bank, as the next step in building out the EU layer of Payward Banking.
Built for clients across Europe

The foundation we’ve built in Ireland supports the products we bring to clients across the EEA. This week, we made Unified Wallet available to EEA clients on Kraken Pro, so clients can use their existing spot, margin, and earn balances as futures collateral without moving funds between wallets. We’ve also brought US-listed stocks to European clients, bridging traditional markets and crypto in one place.
The goal is the same every time: give clients one place to hold, trade, and put their assets to work, backed by the regulatory standards they should expect from a financial institution.
What’s next

We’re proud of this recognition, but we’re even more motivated by what’s ahead. We’ll keep investing in Ireland, keep expanding what we offer to clients across Europe, and keep building the regulated infrastructure that makes it possible. This award is a great milestone, and we’re just getting started.

blocks.x: Rising Trader Boost Multiplier

For the purpose of this Promotion, “Rising Traders” refers to users who, as of three days before the start of the Promotion Period, have won any rewards in fewer than 3 previous Binance Wallet’s Alpha trading competitions.
Eligible Rising Traders will receive a 1.2x Rising Trader Boost on their actual trading volume during the Promotion Period, subject to a Rising Trader Boost Cap.
Notes:
The "Rising Trader" qualification is determined as of three days before the activity period begins.

For example, if a user wins a trading competition ending on Day T, and their cumulative historical win count reaches exactly 3 at that point, they will still qualify as a Rising Trader for new competitions starting on T+1 and T+2 (since the qualification snapshot was taken before their 3rd win). However, for competitions starting on T+3 and beyond, their historical win count will already be 3 or more at the qualification snapshot, and they will no longer be eligible for the Rising Trader bonus.

The Rising Trader Boost Cap refers to the maximum actual trading volume that can receive the Rising Trader Boost during the Promotion Period. Once a user’s Rising Trader Boost Cap has been reached, the user will no longer receive Rising Trader Boosts for any subsequent trading volume.
If both the Early Bird Boost Multiplier and Rising Trader Boost apply, Effective Trading Volume will be calculated as follows:
Effective Trading Volume = Actual Trading Volume * Early Bird Boost Multiplier + min(Actual Trading Volume, Remaining Rising Trader Boost Cap) * Rising Trader Boost

The final ranking will be calculated based on users’ total Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period. A user’s total Effective Trading Volume is the sum of their daily Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period.
Example:

User A generates 10,000 USDT in actual trading volume on Day 1. The Day 1 Early Bird Boost Multiplier is 3.0x, and User A is also eligible for the 1.2x Rising Trader Boost. The Rising Trader Boost Cap is 5,000 USDT.
User A's Day 1 Effective Trading Volume is calculated as follows:
Early Bird Boost: 10,000 * 3.0 = 30,000 USDT

Rising Trader Boost: User A's actual trading volume (10,000 USDT) exceeds the Rising Trader Boost Cap (5,000 USDT), so only 5,000 USDT is eligible for the Rising Trader Boost = 5,000 * 1.2 = 6,000 USDT
Day 1 Effective Trading Volume = 30,000 + 6,000 = 36,000 USDT

After Day 1, User A's 5,000 USDT Rising Trader Boost Cap has been fully used. Therefore, User A will no longer receive the Rising Trader Boost for any subsequent trading volume during the Promotion Period.

Binance is excited to launch the USDC Holding APR Promotion! During the Promotion Period, all eligible users will enjoy a 2% APR reward on their eligible Net USDC Holding in Binance Futures and Portfolio Margin accounts.
Promotion Mechanism
1. Eligible Users

To earn rewards for a weekly period, users must generate at least $2,500 in USDC-margined trading volume (USDC-M Futures pairs) within that weekly period. The Promotion Period consists of four weekly periods:
Weekly Period · Time Frame (UTC)
2. Eligible Asset
USDC balances as defined under "Net USDC Holding" below: Futures account USDC balance for all users, plus Margin account USDC balance for Portfolio Margin users.
3. Eligible Balance

Net USDC Holding: The maximum eligible balance is $1,000,000 Net USDC Holding per user, applied at the master account level. Net USDC Holding across all sub-accounts will be aggregated under the master account. Any amount above $1,000,000 will not earn rewards.
Net USDC Holding is calculated as:
Portfolio Margin users: Portfolio Margin account USDC balance − Portfolio Margin account USDC liability
Non-Portfolio Margin users: Futures account USDC balance − Margin account USDC liability
Notes:
Portfolio Margin: A unified margin mode that lets users share collateral across UM + CM + Margin accounts.
For more information, refer to this Portfolio Margin FAQ.
Margin account USDC liability refers to the total outstanding borrowed USDC in the Margin account.
Negative Net USDC Holding are not eligible to receive rewards.
4. Rewards Calculation & Distribution
Daily reward = min(daily average Net USDC Holding, $1,000,000) × 2% ÷ 365
Net USDC Holding is measured via snapshots taken at random times between 00:00:00 and 23:59:59 (UTC) each day

Rewards accrue daily and are settled weekly: Users who meet the weekly trading volume threshold will receive all rewards accrued during that weekly period. For these purposes, the daily average Net USDC Holding is the average of the Net USDC Holding recorded across that day’s snapshots.
Rewards will be distributed in USDC to the eligible user’s Spot account (master account) within 5 calendar days (excluding weekends and UAE public holidays) after each weekly period ends.

Example: User A maintains a daily average Net USDC Holding of $1,500,000 during Week 1 and generates $3,000 in USDC-margined trading volume in Week 1. User A will receive ($1,000,000 × 2% ÷ 365) × 7 ≈ $383.56 in USDC for Week 1.

Eligible trading pairs: SPCXB/USDT, SKHYB/USDT, MSTRB/USDT, CRCLB/USDT, and NVDAB/USDT

Rules
Users must click the registration button on the campaign landing page to join. Only spot trading volume from the eligible pairs generated after registration will count toward the competition.
The campaign features a prize pool of up to $70,000 in total rewards, and the reward structure is as follows:
1️⃣ Volume Leaderboard: Up to $50,000 in $NVDAB
2️⃣ bStocks Collateral Participation Pool: $20,000 in $ASTER
1. Volume Leaderboard: Up to $50,000 in $NVDAB

Each participant’s reward will be allocated proportionally according to their share of the total eligible trading volume. Estimated rewards will be displayed on the campaign landing page throughout the campaign. Only reward amounts equal to or greater than 0.001 $NVDAB will be distributed.

1️⃣ Total valid volume ≤ 50M: $10,000 in $NVDAB
2️⃣ 50M < Total valid volume ≤ 100M: $30,000 in $NVDAB
3️⃣ Total valid volume > 100M: $50,000 in $NVDAB

1️⃣ Register for the campaign.
2️⃣ Enable Multi-Assets Mode and use eligible bStocks as collateral in their Aster Perpetuals account.
3️⃣ Generate at least $5,000 in perpetual trading volume during the campaign period.
4️⃣ Maintain at least $500 worth of eligible bStocks as collateral in their Aster Perpetuals account during the campaign period.

Distribution: Rewards will be airdropped directly to eligible users’ Spot Accounts of their Binance master accounts.

Reward Distribution
Rewards start accruing from 2026-10-23 00:00 (UTC). Weekly rewards will be distributed by 18:00 (UTC) every Friday in XRP. Distribution records can be found in distribution history.
The Weekly Reward Amount will be roughly calculated as follows:
Qualifying Balance of each day = Lowest RLUSD balance captured during those hourly snapshots on each day.
Weekly Rewards = (7-day average of the Qualifying Balance * Effective APR on the distribution day * 7) / 365

After each weekly distribution, the effective APR for that period will be updated in this announcement. In determining the effective APR on the distribution day, Binance will take into account a number of factors, including, without limitation:
Lowest balance of the snapshots each day;

Each participant may use only one Binance Wallet linked account for the Campaign and may join only one team. If the same account participates through multiple MPC wallets, all participation records and points will be consolidated under that account and will not be treated as separate participants.
Competition Rules

Eligible markets: Match-winner markets associated with League of Legends World Championship matches during the Campaign Period will count. The eligible market scope, match order, and settlement status shown on the Campaign Page will apply.

Eligible channels: Trades must be completed through the Prediction entry point on the Binance App integrated interface or the designated Predict.fun entry point in Binance Wallet. Trades completed through other channels will not count.

Minimum participation amount: For each match, a participant must use their own funds to open positions with an aggregate value of at least 10 USDT in the outcome used for Campaign scoring before the match begins.

Holding requirement: The full eligible position used for Campaign scoring must be held until the corresponding market settles. Positions opened after the match begins, or scoring positions sold in whole or in part before settlement, earn no Match Points and do not satisfy member activation.

Multiple outcomes in the same match: A participant may hold two or more outcomes for the same match. However, only the team or outcome associated with the participant’s first buy order for that match will be treated as the valid prediction for Campaign scoring and member activation. Positions in other outcomes do not create additional scoring records or points.

Eligible funds: Trading vouchers, Trial Funds, bonuses, and other non-self-funded amounts do not count toward the minimum participation amount. If a trade combines the participant’s own funds with subsidized funds, only the self-funded portion will count.
Score precision: Individual and team scores are recorded to two decimal places. Digits after the second decimal place are truncated without rounding.

Member activation: After joining a team, a user must use eligible funds to open at least one eligible position worth at least 10 USDT before kickoff and hold the position used for Campaign scoring until settlement. Once that trade is confirmed as valid, member status and the applicable team bonus take effect from that match onward. Match Points earned before activation are not credited to the team or recalculated retroactively. Favorite-team points already earned are credited once the member becomes eligible. Team members who joined before the team-formation deadline may still activate afterward.

No team changes: Once a user joins a team, the user cannot leave or switch teams, and the team captain cannot remove the user. Users should confirm the team details and available slots before joining.

blocks.x: Campaign Details

Register during the campaign period, meet the cumulative net deposit threshold for any one of USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, or SOL, and keep Hold to Earn enabled for 10 consecutive full calendar days before the observation deadline. Users who complete all requirements and pass eligibility verification will qualify to share the 50,000 USDT prize pool.

Once any one asset meets its threshold, net deposits are calculated separately for all five assets. These net deposit amounts are then converted to USDT equivalent and added together for reward allocation. The other assets do not need to meet their individual thresholds for their net deposits to count.
Each user's reward-eligible net deposits are capped at 1,000,000 USDT equivalent. Amounts above this cap will not increase the user's reward weight.
How to Participate
Register: Click “Enroll Now” during the campaign period.
Complete the Deposit Task: Transfer supported assets from an external platform or wallet to KuCoin and meet at least one asset's cumulative net deposit threshold by the end of the campaign period.
Complete the Hold to Earn Task: Starting at 00:00 on the day after you have both registered and enabled Hold to Earn, keep the feature enabled for 10 consecutive full calendar days.
Share the Rewards: Complete all tasks and pass eligibility verification to share 50,000 USDT in proportion to your reward-eligible net deposits.
The Hold to Earn task must be completed by November 29, 2026, at 23:59 (UTC+8).
Net Deposit Calculation
Cumulative Net Deposits per Asset = Total Eligible External Deposits of That Asset During the Campaign Period − Total External Withdrawals of That Asset During the Campaign Period
Net deposits are calculated separately for USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, and SOL.
Net deposits are counted from the start of the campaign period, rather than from the time of registration.
Internal transfers, transfers between KuCoin accounts, and assets acquired through trading do not count as eligible external deposits.
Deposits and withdrawals after the campaign period do not affect campaign net deposits.
At least one asset must independently meet its threshold. Users do not qualify if no individual asset meets its threshold, even if their combined net deposits exceed 1,000 USDT equivalent.
Conversion Rules

USDT and USDC are counted at a 1:1 ratio to USDT. BTC, ETH, and SOL are converted separately using the arithmetic average of each asset's daily average platform trading prices during the campaign period.
Campaign Conversion Price per Asset = Sum of That Asset's Daily Average Platform Trading Prices During the Campaign Period ÷ Number of Calendar Days in the Campaign Period
Reward Calculation
Combined Net Deposits in USDT Equivalent
= Cumulative USDT Net Deposits + Cumulative USDC Net Deposits
+Cumulative BTC Net Deposits × Campaign BTC Conversion Price
+Cumulative ETH Net Deposits × Campaign ETH Conversion Price
+Cumulative SOL Net Deposits × Campaign SOL Conversion Price
Individual Reward-Eligible Net Deposits = min(Combined Net Deposits in USDT Equivalent, 1,000,000 USDT)
Individual Reward = 50,000 USDT × Individual Reward-Eligible Net Deposits ÷ Total Reward-Eligible Net Deposits of All Qualified Users

Only users meeting all eligibility requirements are included in the reward denominator. Each qualified user's capped reward-eligible net deposit amount is used in the calculation. All rewards are distributed in USDT.
Consecutive Activation Rules
The consecutive-day count starts at 00:00 on the day after both campaign registration and Hold to Earn activation requirements are met.
Users who already have Hold to Earn enabled must also register. Days before registration do not count.
Hold to Earn must remain enabled for 10 consecutive full calendar days. This period may extend beyond the end of the net deposit period.
Disabling Hold to Earn during a qualifying 10-day period resets the consecutive-day count.
Users may enable Hold to Earn again and restart, provided they complete 10 consecutive full calendar days by November 29, 2026, at 23:59 (UTC+8).
Users who do not complete the consecutive activation requirement are not eligible for rewards.

30-Day Average Daily Eligible Net Deposits = Sum of Daily Cumulative Eligible Net Deposit Balances During the Observation Period ÷ 30

Each daily cumulative balance equals eligible external deposits counted from the start of the campaign through that day, minus external withdrawals over the same period. The calculation averages your cumulative daily balances rather than dividing the sum of your daily deposits by 30.

Eligible users can receive 30 days of bonus APR in addition to base rewards, bringing the total APR to up to 7%. Limited to the first 3,000 eligible users. First come, first served.

Both tiers provide a 30-day reward period, with a maximum reward principal of 1,000,000 KCUSD per user.
The indicative total APR combines the current 4% KCUSD base APR with the applicable campaign bonus APR. The base APR is variable, and the rate displayed on the KCUSD product page prevails.
How to Participate
Complete the following steps before the campaign deadline:
Register: Click the registration button on this page to join the campaign.
Deposit: Transfer USDT or USDC into KuCoin from an external wallet or another trading platform.
Subscribe to KCUSD: Use the deposited assets to subscribe to KCUSD and hold it during your observation period to earn eligible bonus rewards.

Your individual observation period runs for 30 consecutive days from the date of your first eligible deposit during the campaign. Registration, additional deposits, and subsequent subscriptions do not restart or extend it. Users who complete these steps on the final campaign day can still complete their full individual observation period.
How Your APR Tier Is Determined

Your balance at the end of the campaign does not, by itself, determine your tier. We calculate your average daily eligible net deposits over your individual 30-day observation period to determine the applicable bonus APR.
30-Day Average Daily Eligible Net Deposits = Sum of Daily Cumulative Eligible Net Deposit Balances During the Observation Period ÷ 30

Each daily cumulative balance equals eligible external deposits counted from the start of the campaign through that day, minus external withdrawals over the same period. The calculation averages your cumulative daily balances rather than dividing the sum of your daily deposits by 30.

For example, if you deposit 100,000 USDT on the first day and make no additional deposits or withdrawals for 30 days, your daily cumulative balance and average daily eligible net deposits will both be 100,000 USDT. This qualifies for the 3% bonus APR tier.
An average below 50,000 USDT equivalent does not qualify for campaign bonus rewards.
How Your Bonus Reward Is Caculated
Eligible net deposits and KCUSD holdings are averaged separately over the same 30-day observation period.
30-Day Average Daily KCUSD Holdings = Sum of Daily KCUSD Snapshot Balances During the Observation Period ÷ 30
Your reward principal is the lowest of
Your 30-day average daily eligible net deposits;
Your 30-day average daily KCUSD holdings;
Bonus Reward = Reward Principal × Applicable Bonus APR × 30 ÷ 365

Both averages use the full 30-day period. Days without KCUSD holdings count as zero, and no separate minimum daily holding requirement applies. You may withdraw or redeem according to your funding needs, but these actions may reduce your average net deposits, average KCUSD holdings, and final reward.
Calculation Example
If your average daily eligible net deposits are 150,000 USDT and your average daily KCUSD holdings are 120,000 KCUSD, you qualify for a 3% bonus APR on a reward principal of 120,000 KCUSD.
Your estimated campaign bonus reward is: 120,000 × 3% × 30 ÷ 365 ≈ 295.89 KCUSD
This amount excludes KCUSD base rewards, which are calculated and distributed separately under the product rules. Actual campaign rewards are subject to the final calculation.
Eligible Deposits and Transfers

Only USDT and USDC transferred to KuCoin during the campaign from an external wallet, blockchain address, or another trading platform qualify as eligible external deposits, measured in USDT equivalent.

Eligible deposits and external withdrawals made during the campaign before registration are included. Registration does not reset your observation period. Deposits made after the campaign ends are excluded, while external withdrawals made before your individual observation period ends continue to be deducted.

Internal transfers do not count toward eligible net deposits. These include transfers between KuCoin accounts, between main accounts and sub-accounts, and between Funding, Trading, Earn, or other internal accounts. Subscribing to KCUSD using existing funds redeemed or released at maturity from other KuCoin Earn products does not create an eligible external deposit.
Reward Distribution

KCUSD base rewards continue to be distributed under the product rules. Campaign bonus rewards are calculated separately after your individual 30-day observation period and distributed in KCUSD in batches.

The first batch will be distributed within 10 days after registration closes to eligible users who have completed their observation periods. Users whose observation periods have not yet ended will be included in subsequent batches after completion and eligibility verification.
Holdings above the campaign reward principal may continue to earn base rewards under the product rules, but the excess does not qualify for this campaign’s bonus APR.

blocks.x: Since June, Ondo Perps has paid out over 3.5 million USDC in rewards to traders. Every week, a 175,000 USDC pool was shared based on trading activity. The more you traded, the bigger your share was.

Now, we're upgrading the USDC Rewards Program. Starting this week, from Tuesday 27 Oct 00:00 UTC to Monday 2 Nov 23:59 UTC, rewards will be increased to 220,000 USDC, and will be split across three separate pools:
Liquidity Pool: Earn by providing resting liquidity on the books of eligible markets.
Volume Pool: Earn by trading any market on Ondo Perps as a maker or taker.
Trading Activity Pool: Earn from a bonus activity that changes each week.
Each pool pays out on its own, so you can earn from one, two, or all three in the same week.
Whichever way you trade, there's now a pool for it. The more you trade, the more you can earn.
Liquidity Pool
The Liquidity Pool allows traders to earn USDC for keeping resting liquidity on the books of eligible markets. The closer your orders sit to the mid price, the bigger your share of the pool:
Resting liquidity within 25 bps of the mid price earns
85% of the pool goes to liquidity from mid to 5 bps
10% to 6–10 bps
5% to 11–25 bps
This week’s pool is split evenly across markets, with 5,000 USDC per market each week.

Snapshots of the order books are taken at random, roughly once a minute, so consistent quoting earns the most. One-sided quotes qualify, and a smaller book quoted tightly can out-earn a larger one quoted wide.
This week’s Liquidity Pool will pay out a total of 100,000 USDC to eligible traders.
This Week’s Eligible Markets
These 20 perps markets are eligible for Liquidity Pool rewards:
Stocks: NVDA, TSLA, META, AMD, INTC, MU, SNDK, COIN, MSTR, CRCL, SPCX
Indices: US 500, US 100
ETFs: DRAM, SOXL
Commodities: Gold, Silver, WTI
Crypto: BTC, ETH
The list is subject to change over time. Any changes are announced at the start of a reward week.
Volume Pool
Earn USDC simply by trading any perps market on Ondo Perps. Your share is based on your trading volume, and maker and taker volume both count.
This week, the Volume Pool will pay out a total of 100,000 USDC to eligible traders.
Trading Activity Pool
A bonus pool that rotates rewards criteria periodically. Each week's activity is announced when the week opens.
This week: trade OpenAI exposure and earn from a pool of 20,000 USDC. Trading the OpenAI Private Market Note on spot (OPAIPon) and the OpenAI perp both count toward your share.
When You Get Paid

Refer traders and earn a bonus equal to 5% of the trading points they earn, with no cap on how many traders you can refer. Referral points are retroactive to the start of the points program and continue through the end of Season 1.
How It Works
When a trader you refer earns points through trading volume and open interest, you earn an additional 5% in referral points. These points are added to your total without reducing theirs.

The same 5% bonus applies to both past and future trading points earned by referred traders in Season 1. The retroactive points drop today.
More Ways to Earn Ondo Points

All referral points are in addition to the fixed 5 million points distributed weekly to Perps traders in Season 1. They are posted alongside regular points in the weekly update and count toward your total on the Season 1 leaderboard.
More Details

Referral bonuses apply only to trading points earned through volume and open interest. Referral points do not generate further referral points. The referral bonus applies to points only, not USDC Rewards.
Eligibility restrictions and anti-wash checks apply. Wallets excluded from USDC Rewards cannot earn referral points. Referred traders excluded from rewards do not generate referral points.

1.Definition of Futures Bonus
The platform provides Futures Bonus subsidies according to a specified loss-offset ratio, helping reduce traders' actual trading costs.
After receiving a Futures Bonus voucher, users must activate it first. The activated bonus is then combined with the user's own funds as futures margin, increasing the margin available for positions.
2.Key Rules
01 | Activate Before Use
After claiming a Futures Bonus voucher, follow the instructions on the page to activate it. Once activation is successful, it can be used for eligible futures trades.
02 | Combined Margin
The activated Futures Bonus and the user’s own funds jointly form futures margin and can be used to cover position losses and related funding costs.
03 | Losses Offset According to a Ratio
When a loss occurs, the Futures Bonus and the user’s own funds share the loss according to the offset ratio configured by the platform.
Offset Ratio · How Losses Are Covered
100% · Losses are deducted from the Futures Bonus first. Once the bonus is depleted, the user’s own funds are deducted according to the applicable rules.
cells: Losses are deducted from the Futures Bonus first. Once the bonus is depleted, the user’s own funds are deducted according to the applicable rules.

blocks.x: 50% · 50% of the loss is deducted from the Futures Bonus, and the remaining 50% is deducted from the user's own funds.
cells: 50% of the loss is deducted from the Futures Bonus, and the remaining 50% is deducted from the user's own funds.

blocks.x: Note: The higher the offset ratio, the greater the share of losses covered by the Futures Bonus. The actual offset method is subject to the platform configuration.
04 | Trading Fees Are Deducted from Your Own Funds First
Trading fees are not deducted from the Futures Bonus and must be paid using the user's own funds. If those funds are insufficient, the platform's rules apply.
05 | Not Directly Withdrawable

The Futures Bonus principal itself cannot be withdrawn and may only be used for eligible trades under the applicable rules. Profits generated through the use of the Futures Bonus may be withdrawn in accordance with the rules.
06 | Minimum Own-Funds Requirement
The user's futures account must hold a minimum amount of their own funds to redeem and activate the Futures Bonus.
07 | Multiple Position Openings Supported

After activation, the Futures Bonus may support multiple position openings under the applicable rules. However, only one Futures Bonus with a given offset ratio may be used to open positions in the same account at any one time.
08 | Bonus Recovery and Risk Warning

When the Futures Bonus expires, the platform will recover it according to the applicable rules. Recovery may reduce the account’s available margin and could result in insufficient margin, position reduction or liquidation, or the inability to maintain open orders. Please monitor your positions and margin in a timely manner.
3.Activation and Usage Process
1.Obtain the Benefit
Obtain a Futures Bonus voucher through official campaigns, a dedicated Business Development (BD) representative, or other designated channels.
2.Check Voucher Details
Select More in the navigation bar, then go to Rewards Hub → My Vouchers to view all vouchers you have received, including voucher type, amount, validity period, offset ratio, and usage requirements.
3.Activate the Futures Bonus
The Futures Bonus must be activated first. Confirm that your futures account meets the minimum own-funds requirement; otherwise, activation will fail.
Select “Use Now” to start activation. When the prompt “Trade Now” appears, activation is complete.
4.Trade Futures
Trade within the scope specified by the benefit, and monitor margin, trading fees, funding rates, and position risk.
After activation, the voucher status changes to “Used,” and the funds are included in futures margin.
Go to Funds → Futures Account to view the Futures Bonus balance.
On the USDT-M Futures page, the available funds for opening a position will reflect the increased margin balance.
5.Check Settlement Results
Review benefit usage, trading profit and loss, and withdrawable profits according to the applicable benefit rules.
Go to Funds → Futures Orders → Transaction History to filter and view Futures Bonus fund flows.
4.Withdrawal and Restriction Rules
a. Transfers from the Futures Account
Any transfer from the futures account to another account will cause the credited Futures Bonus to be reset to zero.
b. Profits Can Be Withdrawn in Full
The Futures Bonus principal itself cannot be withdrawn or transferred, but trading profits generated from it may be withdrawn in full.
c. For Personal Use Only
The Futures Bonus cannot be gifted, sold, or monetized in any other way. Trading volume generated using the Futures Bonus is not eligible for trading-fee rebate programs.
d. Only One Voucher Can Be Activated at a Time
If multiple Futures Bonus vouchers are available in the account, redeeming a new one will invalidate the Futures Bonus currently in use in the futures account.
